4K IPTV

4K IPTV in the UK, done properly

A 4K picture is only as good as the weakest link between our server and your sofa. Here is what you need, and what to check if it looks soft.

See plans from £7Ask for a free trial

What you need for 4K

  • Broadband: at least 25 Mbps available to the device, ideally more if others in the house are streaming too.
  • A 4K screen: any 4K (UHD) Smart TV or monitor.
  • A 4K-capable device: Fire TV Stick 4K or 4K Max, Nvidia Shield, a good Android TV box, Apple TV 4K or the TV’s own apps.
  • An app that plays 4K: TiviMate, IPTV Smarters Pro and IBO Player all do.

Wired beats wireless

Most 4K problems in British homes come from Wi-Fi, not the service. If your router is in the hallway and the telly is in the back room, try an Ethernet cable, a powerline adapter or a mesh system. It often makes the difference between stuttering and smooth.

What about 8K IPTV?

You may see “8K IPTV UK” advertised. Very little is broadcast in 8K, few homes have an 8K TV, and the broadband needed is far higher. For now, good 4K and stable HD matter much more than an 8K label.

When 4K looks blurry

Check your speed with the device itself (not your phone), restart the router, close other streams in the house and pick the 4K version of the channel rather than the HD one. Still not right? Our buffering guide covers the rest, or message us.

FAQ

Questions people ask

What internet speed do I need for 4K IPTV?

We recommend at least 25 Mbps for 4K and 10 Mbps for HD, measured on the device you watch on.

Is every channel in 4K?

No. 4K is available where the source is in 4K. Every channel has an HD version, which is the best choice on slower connections.

Which Firestick is best for 4K IPTV?

The Fire TV Stick 4K or 4K Max. The basic Fire TV Stick tops out at 1080p.
